release_performance.selection: Three alternating paired release measurements of two full novel modes and an explicit dense 1024-token deictic workload. Wall-clock observations on this machine during browser validation; not statistical equivalence or a throughput guarantee.

validation_corrections.resolution: Two original snapshots gain three open-ㅕ lexical hypotheses. Every added path reviewed and old fingerprints retained; exact pre-vowel output is checked before all old polite/spelling-history assertions. No production cap or output removal.

First-paragraph boundary now begins at byte zero when no previous blank-line delimiter exists. Original analyzer UTF-8 span assertions passed; correction applies only to evidence extraction, not production tokenization.

remaining_original_scope: COV-021k explicitly tracks the still-retained compatible hypotheses 받아싸→받아쓰다, 가냘퍼→가냘프다 and 약어→약다. Complete native forms and independent norms must support any future per-entry conflict; current raw/headword hypotheses remain.
All other 79 written-form discrepancies and all 67 complex written forms remain unjudged, including modern 거라/너라 compounds, deictic variants, aliases and apparent source errors.
The unchanged 보살펴온 segmentation discrepancy requires independent corpus/lexical review.
Context, outer particle followers and raw unknown lexical hypotheses require source-specific judgment; dictionary matching does not certify them.
Every-entry grammar inventory audit, independent Korean-language review and fresh representative passages remain required.
All other unchecked requirements of docs/coverage-checklist.md remain in scope.
interpretation: The new generic recovery applies only to open ㅕ stems; finite written exceptions match exact whole forms. Existing contraction/harmony alternatives, analysis order and every old dictionary assessment remain. No arbitrary compound segmentation, spelling correction, contextual pruning, candidate cap or new dictionary policy.
